clips.title: The story
paras: In Old Town, Nikova Raskol grieves for her murdered grandson. The elderly Stormwind townswoman seeks justice against the Defias Brotherhood rioters held in the Stockade.

Nikova Raskol wanders Old Town, carrying the grief of a recent loss. Her beloved grandson, Mac, was slain by Defias Brotherhood brigands. While the kingdom faces treason on a grand scale, Nikova bears the private cost of the Brotherhood's lawless rampage.

Many criminals who wrecked havoc were captured and locked in the Stockade, but a violent inmate rebellion has seized the prison. The guards have failed to restore order, and Nikova turns to adventurers heading inside. She asks them to bring back red Defias bandanas as proof that her grandson's killers have faced retribution.
